posts.title: Creative Writing at National Taiwan Museum of Literature
posts.description: Last week, I was in our former home-town of Tainan, where I was running a creative writing workshop with a brilliant group of international translators at the National Museum of Taiwan Literature. At Wind&Bones Books, we were invited to the run the workshop as part of NMTL’s annual week-long intensive translation workshop. posts.title: Creative Journeys at Taitung University
posts.description: Four the last three years now, we have been regular visitors to Taitung University, where we have given lectures about our work at Wind&Bones, at the invitation of Dr. Ching-yueh Hsieh. posts.title: Taiwan-Ireland Poetry Translation Prize
posts.description: As a student of Taiwanese, I like a challenge. And so when, earlier this year, the Taiwan-Ireland poetry translation competition was announced, with the challenge of translating three poems by Jocelyn Wen (Un Jio̍k-kiâu 温若喬) into English, I thought I’d throw my hat into the ring.
